_meta.purpose: Verses-per-chapter for the Pauline corpus. Two uses: (1) expand cross-chapter verse ranges (Rom 7:25-8:2 needs to know Rom 7 ends at v.25); (2) reject out-of-range citations (Phlm 6:15 -> Philemon has 1 chapter -> divert).
_meta.scope: Pauline corpus only (13 letters). Gospels/Acts/Catholic epistles excluded by design (versification variance).
_meta.versification: KJV-inclusive: each value is the highest verse number of that chapter in standard versification. KJV chosen because it is the MAXIMAL common numbering (e.g. 2 Cor 13 = 14 verses; NA/UBS merge 13:13-14), so validation never falsely rejects a citation that uses a fuller numbering.
